sections.title: Headline

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today’s repo-level momentum is concentrated in practical agent infrastructure: agents that can operate desktop apps, retain context, work in parallel, and follow structured processes. The concurrent rise of semantic data grounding and local developer tooling points to a focus on making agent workflows more dependable and easier to run. Treat performance and product claims as project descriptions, not independent validation.
